enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Damage Reduction 15/-: Reduces all physical damage by 15.
Insightful Command: Passive: +5 Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.
Charisma +9: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.

Radiance Guard: This item is imbued with a brilliant, radiant power. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, the attacker has a chance of being hit by 4d6 points of light damage and has a chance of being blinded.
